zh: 以位置 i 结尾的最优非空片段，要么只包含 a[i]，要么是以 i−1 结尾的最优片段再接上 a[i]。
扫描时维护“以当前元素结尾的最大片段和” ending，以及到目前为止所有 ending 的最大值；这就是 Kadane 算法。
用第一个元素初始化 ending 和 answer（保证全负数组也选非空片段）；对后续每个值 v，ending = max(v, ending+v)，answer = max(answer, ending)；最后输出 answer，求和用 64 位整数。
en: The best non-empty segment ending at position i either contains only a[i] or is the best segment ending at i - 1 extended by a[i].
While scanning keep ending, the best sum of a segment ending at the current element, and the maximum of all endings so far; this is Kadane's algorithm.

Initialise ending and answer with the first element (so an all-negative array still picks a non-empty segment); for every later value v set ending = max(v, ending + v) and answer = max(answer, ending); print answer, using 64-bit sums.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Keep the best sum of a non-empty segment ending at the current element, and the maximum of that value over all end positions.

## Proof of correctness

A segment ending at i either contains only a[i] or consists of the best segment ending at i-1 extended by a[i]. These two kinds cover all non-empty segments; initializing with the first element guarantees that a non-empty segment is chosen even when all values are negative.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space apart from the input storage; sums use 64-bit integers.
